mode: RESUME. Loops A, B, E carried forward unchanged from commit 1c2e082. Loops C, D, F, G, H, I re-run.
style_string_note: channel.config.json was corrected to the ISO contract this run. The asserted string, the config value and the scenes.json hash from the previous run are all byte-identical, which independently confirms the correction.

prompt_injection.method: Prompts were built programmatically from config + scenes.json into frame_prompts.json / clip_prompts.json before any generation call.
prompt_injection.transport_caveat: Higgsfield is reachable only over MCP in this environment (no HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY), so each prompt necessarily passed through a tool-call argument rather than an HTTP body written by a script.
prompt_injection.mitigation: Every generation echoes back the prompt the API actually received. All 40 frame prompts and all 40 clip prompts were diffed byte-for-byte against the programmatically built files.

clips_engine: higgsfield kling3_0, mode=pro, sound=off, 5s, image-to-video from the approved frame job id
clips_engine_note: mode=std returned 1280x720, which would not have matched the 1920x1080 still holds. mode=pro returns native 1920x1080 and was used for all 40 clips.

frame_retries.reason: OCR detected glyph-like artefacts on the calendar grid
OCR detected a glyph-like artefact on the state map
OCR detected glyph-like artefacts on the ruled utility bill

clip_retries.reason: ACCENT_RULE_VIOLATION: the clip introduced emerald at t=4.9s on a non-green beat; the source frame carries none

contract_checks.emerald_on_exactly_one_beat: PASS. Beat 17 carries 8.86% emerald; the other 39 frames peak at 0.20% (noise floor). Beat 21's clip violation was regenerated and now reads 0.000 throughout.
contract_checks.no_lettering_in_generated_frames: PASS by OCR (tesseract psm 11, confidence >=70). 0 of 40 frames carry a confident glyph run after retries.
contract_checks.true_isometric_no_convergence: NOT MACHINE-VERIFIED. Requires a human eye; see limitations.
contract_checks.matte_no_gloss_no_specular: NOT MACHINE-VERIFIED. Requires a human eye; see limitations.
contract_checks.shadow_soft_long_down_and_right: NOT MACHINE-VERIFIED. Requires a human eye; see limitations.
contract_checks.figures_faceless_consistent_scale: NOT MACHINE-VERIFIED. Requires a human eye; see limitations.
contract_checks.closed_palette: 93.6% of sampled pixels sit within tolerance of a palette entry; the remainder is shading interpolation between palette entries plus the contract's own film grain. Contract A applies the literal palette to composed elements, which are 100% palette-bound via palette.css.

clip_checks.one_action_per_clip: PASS by frame-delta. All 40 clips show motion (mean frame delta 1.29 to 24.76); none are static.
clip_checks.accent_does_not_change_mid_clip: PASS after the beat 21 regeneration. Beat 17 holds emerald 0.081 to 0.125 across the clip; no other clip exceeds 0.005.
clip_checks.locked_off_camera: INCONCLUSIVE BY MACHINE. Border-ring drift stays low on 35 of 40 clips and a whole-frame alignment test found no global translation on the 5 with higher drift, but on a flat sage ground these proxies cannot separate a camera move from a large object moving near frame edge. Needs a human eye.
clip_checks.no_lettering_in_clips: NOT MACHINE-VERIFIED per frame. Source frames are clean and no clip prompt requests text.
clip_checks.audio: All 40 clips carry no audio stream, as required.

per_frame_visual_review: OUTSTANDING. The Read tool's image path became unreachable partway through this run, so only the beat 1 pilot frame was inspected by eye. Everything else was verified programmatically. A human pass over the 40 frames and 40 clips is still required.
limitations: Image-based visual inspection was unavailable after the pilot frame; the checks marked NOT MACHINE-VERIFIED above were not performed.
OCR is a proxy for the no-lettering rule. It cleared all 40 frames but cannot prove the absence of non-glyph marks.
Camera-lock verification on a flat background is not reliably automatable; see clip_checks.
